Suffix Field Force Management
Real-Time Field Force Tracking and Monitoring Solution.
Field Force Management Platform

This application incorporates cutting-edge technologies to provide advanced scheduling and workforce management solutions that are accessible to the organization. SFFMS provides you with an end-to-end visibility of the field operations and business processes, with native mobile app support across all major mobile platforms for you to know in real-time about your business.

 Job Scheduling

Schedule jobs to the local agent automatically. Share records, as well as other appointment detailing together with field force without possessing to be in business office.

 Live Tracking

Auto assigned task to local and free field push agent after creation of recent task. Field force broker gets instant notification to take new task.

 Automate Assignment

Auto assigned task to nearest and free field force agent upon creation of new task. Field force agent gets instant notification to accept new task

 Offline Data Synchronization

The employees, using our field support mobile app, can employ this software in offline function in case there is internet connectivity concerns. Automatic syncing with net starts as soon for the reason that network connection will end up being restored. The intelligent harmonisation feature activates data safe-keeping in offline mode to be able to make sure the information can be very easily downloaded inside online setting.
